Get a few pennies collecting scrap. Owe more in docking fees. Run out of fuel, not to be able to afford to leave the station to fly to an unknown location to investigate a dead body. Get debt-locked. Uninstall. 

There a harsh games. But this takes the cake.

Also - pixelated 2d clutter on the floor makes no sense, you have no clue what to salvage and what to ignore. And, no real flight, just an old radar style screen with more 2d map navigation.

 Avoid.

避开。

items.text:
I love this game to death, I love its concept, I love the mechanics, I love how each update added a lot of brand new content to the game. I love the ship building, I love the writing, I love the lore, I love the music....

I can't recommed this game. The main reason is that it doesn't respect your time. This is a multi layered issue and I'll explain.

In its state that it has been for years (and will resume to be), the game just runs like complete and utter ♥♥♥♥ and the performance has only gotten far worse. The game is optimized for higher end rigs so if you got a mediocre laptop, you'll struggle to run it. I've lost countless hours combined from crashes and corrupt saves, that's another big flaw. The game will save but in the save folder, the save.info file will be missing so you think you saved the game, quit and you lost all your work. With the 0.15 update, the patch notes toted that they upgraded performance. That's bs, the game runs worse on a fresh save than it did before. More crashes as well, BUT, it does handle long running games better than it did before, I'll give them that. So the baseline performance of the game was hampered, the garbage control (RAM reallocation) improved so you no longer have to restart your game ideally every 2 hours (that's right, that used to be a thing, there were AND STILL ARE serious memory leak issues). Big ships will slow your game down heavily, and this promotes the same limiting mentality on creativity that dwarf fortress also possesses: You limit your projects to something smaller scale so the engine/your pc can run the game and it doesn't run on 2 FPS as your projects become more entropic.

There's a lot of other issues that fall under the curtain and get brushed aside because the game is still in early access, but just because a game is in early access, doesn't give it a forcefield from criticism that disallows it from getting any flak for the current state of implemented features. I say this because I want to address some core features of the game that are flawed on a fundamental level, that are broken but not because the game is in early access. That's the other thing. It's the assumption that a feature, mechanic, system in an early access game is going to get fixed or improved once 1.0 comes out or after. No, these cases are rare to begin with and it varies from feature to feature. The AI's piloting is ♥♥♥♥, has always been ♥♥♥♥ and will resume to be ♥♥♥♥, the AI on station is also just surface level implementation, though the social combat system looks really in-depth, it's incredibly shallow, as most social actions are boilerplate. There have been tweaks and modifications to AI behavior in patch notes and this is the state they are in after so much refinement. Not very encouraging.

The monthly update reports that I viewed ever since 0.13.x days have had many niche logic bugs that come from the inherent complex systems of the game (temperature, durability, inventory system, weight etc.). This makes it far harder and much slower to diagnose and address game breaking bugs. The team's progress is glacial, and a lot of their efforts are spent on trying to maintain the game in a playable state, which they are failing at.

If we removie all that negativity, you have the economy system which is the progression path of the game as you start from a junker ship and a mortgage. The economy is busted and imbalanced, money is completely trivial and it neither rewards the player for hard work, neither does it punish appropriately like when they break the law or pay fines for overdue payments. You can commit a murder and the cops will fine you 15.000 dollars which is a pitance. That mortgage is also getting paid off really fast, don't worry. 

Gameplay wise, the game as a sandbox is pretty empty. Still is in version 0.15 even after they added ship combat and asteroid mining. You have little to no insentive sadly because it's again unbalanced. AI just sits there and takes it while you shoot them, they can't battle with you properly because the piloting AI is so bad. Asteroid mining is subpar to trading wares OR the even more busted gig economy, which was broken even more with the addition of long range travel. You can now pickup a gig in Kleg, Venus or Ceres that's on another planet, have it pay a premium because it's a few astral units away from your location, take a ferry to said location instantly (yes INSTANTLY, they don't even bother simulating travel time with a ferry) and voila, you just made 4-9 million dollars with 0 effort.

So the game is unbalanced, runs like a corpse, the AI is braindead, so what else is there? The main thing? Shipbuilding. That's it. Shipbuilding. It does it really ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ well and it's super fun and relaxing to build your ship. It's a really cathartic process. You get to build your mini home in space and there's seriously indepth customization for it (waiting for them to add planters to the sundries kiosk). It's the main selling point of the game. It's just a shame that other features in the game aren't polished to even a fraction of a fraction that shipbuilding has. Also, sadly, shipbuilding takes a long time to do in general (stripping apart ships, putting them together, repairing them, etc.) and you can't realistically do this whilst also juggling a fulltime job, or have a life. Ostranauts is not for people who have limited time.

TL;DR: Ostranauts has a lot of amazing ideas and concepts but fails at executing them. It runs really bad (lots of crashes and corrupt saves, lots of memory leak within a short amount of time), its AI is really simplistic and has no depth to it, the combat is shamefully undercooked and easy, economy is completely unbalanced which doesn't challenge or reward the player, development is super slow and the updates don't address core fundamental issues... but hey, the shipbuilding is fun.

I hate it but I'll still play it and keep following the development closely. I already know realistically what the devs can and can't do with the shoestring budget they got and the time they have but still praying for a miracle cause I care about Ostranauts. I know the game's performance will forever be ♥♥♥♥, that the AI will forever be stupid and boring, that the economy will be broken and unbalanced, and that the combat will be busted and favor the player... but I still hold out some hope. As it is though, this game isn't for anyone who has a life

我爱这款游戏爱到死，我爱它的概念，我爱它的机制，我爱每次更新都为游戏添加大量全新内容。我爱造船，我爱它的文字，我爱它的背景设定，我爱它的音乐……

我不能推荐这款游戏。主要原因是它不尊重你的时间。这是一个多层次的问题，我会解释。

在它多年来一直处于（并将继续处于）的状态下，游戏运行起来就像一坨彻头彻尾的♥♥♥♥，而且性能只会越来越糟。游戏是为高端配置优化的，所以如果你只有一台平庸的笔记本电脑，你会很难运行它。我因为崩溃和存档损坏已经累计损失了无数小时，这是另一个大缺陷。游戏会保存，但在存档文件夹里，save.info文件会缺失，所以你以为自己保存了游戏，退出后就丢失了所有工作成果。随着0.15更新，补丁说明吹嘘他们升级了性能。那是胡说八道，游戏在新存档上运行得比以前更糟。崩溃也更多了，但是，它处理长时间运行的游戏确实比以前好了，这点我承认。所以游戏的基础性能被削弱了，垃圾控制（RAM重新分配）改善了，所以你不再需要理想情况下每2小时重启一次游戏（没错，这曾经是常态，曾经存在而且现在仍然存在严重的内存泄漏问题）。大型飞船会严重拖慢你的游戏，这助长了与《矮人要塞》相同的限制创造力的心态：你把项目限制在较小规模，这样引擎/你的电脑才能运行游戏，不至于随着你的项目变得更加混乱而让游戏以2 FPS运行。

还有很多其他问题被掩盖在帷幕之下，被搁置一旁，因为游戏仍处于抢先体验阶段，但仅仅因为一款游戏处于抢先体验阶段，并不意味着它有一层免受批评的力场，不允许它因当前已实现功能的状态而受到任何抨击。我这么说是因为我想指出游戏中一些在根本层面上就有缺陷的核心功能，它们是坏的，但并不是因为游戏处于抢先体验阶段。这是另一回事。那就是一种假设，认为抢先体验游戏中的某个功能、机制、系统会在1.0发布时或之后得到修复或改进。不，这些情况本来就很少见，而且因功能而异。AI的驾驶技术是♥♥♥♥，一直都是♥♥♥♥，并将继续是♥♥♥♥，空间站上的AI也只是表面层次的实现，虽然社交战斗系统看起来非常深入，但它极其肤浅，因为大多数社交行动都是模板化的。补丁说明中对AI行为有过调整和修改，这就是经过如此多打磨后它们所处的状态。不太令人鼓舞。

自0.13.x时代以来我查看的每月更新报告中有许多小众逻辑错误，这些错误来自游戏固有的复杂系统（温度、耐久度、库存系统、重量等）。这使得诊断和解决破坏游戏的错误变得更加困难和缓慢。团队的进展如冰川般缓慢，他们的很多精力都花在试图维持游戏的可玩状态上，而他们在这方面正在失败。

如果我们去掉所有这些负面内容，你还有经济系统，它是游戏的进程路径，因为你从一艘破烂飞船和一笔抵押贷款开始。经济系统是崩坏的且不平衡的，金钱完全微不足道，它既不奖励玩家的辛勤工作，也不在玩家违法或为逾期付款缴纳罚款时进行适当的惩罚。你可以犯下谋杀罪，警察只会罚你15,000美元，这简直是杯水车薪。那笔抵押贷款也会很快还清，别担心。

从玩法上看，这款游戏作为沙盒相当空洞。即使在0.15版本中，即使他们添加了飞船战斗和小行星采矿，情况依然如此。遗憾的是，你几乎没有动力，因为它再次不平衡。AI只是坐在那里挨打，当你射击它们时，它们无法与你正常战斗，因为驾驶AI太差了。小行星采矿不如交易货物，也不如更加崩坏的零工经济，而后者随着长途旅行的加入变得更加崩坏。你现在可以在Kleg、Venus或Ceres接一个在另一个星球上的零工，因为它离你的位置有几个天文单位远而支付溢价，然后立即乘坐渡轮前往该地点（是的，立即，他们甚至懒得模拟渡轮的旅行时间），瞧，你刚刚以0努力赚了400万到900万美元。

所以游戏不平衡，运行得像一具尸体，AI是脑死亡的，那还有什么？主要的东西？造船。就是这样。造船。它做得非常♥♥♥♥♥♥♥好，建造你的飞船超级有趣且放松。这是一个非常宣泄的过程。你可以建造你在太空中的迷你家园，而且有非常深入的定制（等待他们在杂货亭添加花盆）。这是游戏的主要卖点。只是遗憾的是，游戏中的其他功能连造船功能的一小部分的一小部分都没有打磨到。而且，遗憾的是，造船总体上需要很长时间（拆解飞船、组装、修理等），你无法在兼顾全职工作或拥有生活的同时现实地做到这一点。Ostranauts不适合时间有限的人。

TL;DR：Ostranauts有很多惊人的想法和概念，但在执行上失败了。它运行得非常糟糕（大量崩溃和存档损坏，短时间内大量内存泄漏），它的AI非常简陋且没有深度，战斗可耻地欠火候且简单，经济完全不平衡，既不挑战也不奖励玩家，开发超级缓慢，更新没有解决核心根本问题……但是嘿，造船很有趣。

我讨厌它，但我仍然会玩它并密切关注开发进展。我已经现实地知道开发者用他们那点微薄预算和有限时间能做什么和不能做什么，但仍然祈祷奇迹，因为我在乎Ostranauts。我知道游戏的性能将永远是♥♥♥♥，AI将永远愚蠢无聊，经济将永远崩坏不平衡，战斗将永远崩坏且偏向玩家……但我仍然抱有一些希望。不过就目前而言，这款游戏不适合任何有生活的人

[b]Ostranauts is a good game but it comes with some very real flaws.[/b]
There’s something deeply satisfying about drifting through a space scrapyard, carefully dismantling derelict ships piece by piece, repairing components, and selling them for profit. The salvage loop is addictive. Strip a wreck, haul the parts, patch up what you can, flip it for cash, and repeat. If that core gameplay loop clicks with you, it REALLY clicks.
Personally, I had a lot of fun. The issues didn’t bother me enough to ruin the experience. However, many negative reviews focus on the following problems (and they’re not wrong):

1. There is a recurring slowdown bug where the game noticeably lags every now and then; search for "stuttering". It’s especially frustrating on older machines. On top of that, load and save times are inexplicably slow. 
2. The UI is horible, sorry to be blunt. Control windows take up two-thirds of the screen for no clear reason. Many actions require excessive clicking. Installing and dismantling or repairing items are buried in separate menus with their own submenus. It feels like a design straight out of the late 1990s.
In a game this complex, usability matters.  That’s difficult to justify in 2026.
3. The AI is not strong: even simple actions require heavy micromanagement. I hired a crew member to assist with scavenging and ended up firing her because:
- She did almost nothing useful.
- She somehow got fined for reasons I still don’t understand.
- Managing her required more effort than doing the work myself.
After firing her, she refused to leave my ship despite repeated orders. I eventually had to dismantle the chair under her just to make her move and offboard (!). That should not be a solution.
There are more examples, but the pattern is consistent: crew management currently feels more like babysitting than delegation.
4. On a similar side, character interaction feels sterile and mechanically shallow. The GUI makes it even harder to manage conversations and relationships smoothly. The RPG layer (quests, social systems, etc) is superficial. It works for the first hour or so, but after that I skipped quests entirely. The salvage gameplay loop is far stronger than the narrative systems right now.
5. Ship Planner is outisde the game?!?! The ship planner being external to the game is baffling. It’s clearly still in alpha and not particularly user-friendly. For most in-game purposes, it’s barely helpful.
What’s needed is something integrated and intuitive i.e closer to the planning systems in Prison Architect. As it stands, it is completely disconnected from actual gameplay.
6. The economy is poorly balanced: after just a few hours and two or three scrapyard trips, money stops being an issue entirely. I’m currently sitting on 9 million space dollars. There’s no real financial pressure once you understand the salvage loop.
For example, I rebuilt a tiny 50k derelict wiht no functional engine into a full-fledged space cruiser with a fusion reactor, seven hydrogen tanks, and enough thrust for 3G acceleration. Final value: 3 million. That progression feels great, but the economic curve flattens far too quickly.

The Good News: the developer clearly tapped into something special... The game is actively maintained — 35 patches in the last year alone, including 7 major ones. More content is on the way (though the upcoming space combat patch is raising some eyebrows). There’s variety, depth in the salvage mechanics, and a genuinely compelling systems-driven core.
If the developer addresses even a couple of the major issues listed above, this could easily become a game that provides dozens, if not hundreds, of hours of entertainment.
Already now, it’s a flawed but very enjoyable experience.
That's why it gets my thumbs up.

[b]Ostranauts是一款好游戏，但它也带有一些非常真实的缺陷。[/b]
在太空废料场中漂移，仔细地一艘艘拆解废弃飞船，修理部件，然后卖掉它们获利，这其中有一种深深的满足感。打捞循环令人上瘾。拆解一艘残骸，拖运零件，能修的就修，转手换钱，然后重复。如果这个核心玩法循环对你来说对味，那它真的非常对味。
就个人而言，我玩得非常开心。这些问题并没有烦扰我到毁掉体验的程度。然而，许多负面评测都集中在以下问题上（而且他们说得没错）：

1. 存在一个反复出现的减速bug，游戏时不时会明显卡顿；搜索“stuttering”就能看到。在较老的机器上尤其令人沮丧。除此之外，加载和保存时间也慢得莫名其妙。
2. UI很糟糕，抱歉说得这么直白。控制窗口毫无明确理由地占据屏幕三分之二。许多操作需要过度点击。安装、拆解或修理物品被埋在各自带有子菜单的独立菜单里。感觉就像是直接从20世纪90年代末搬出来的设计。
在一款如此复杂的游戏里，可用性很重要。这在2026年很难说得过去。
3. AI不强：即便是简单的行动也需要大量微操。我雇了一名船员来协助拾荒，最后却把她解雇了，因为：
- 她几乎没做什么有用的事。
- 她不知怎么就被罚款了，原因我至今都不明白。
- 管理她比我自己干活还要费劲。
解雇她之后，尽管我反复下令，她还是拒绝离开我的飞船。我最后不得不拆掉她坐着的椅子，才让她动起来并离船（！）。这不该成为解决办法。
还有更多例子，但模式是一致的：目前船员管理感觉更像是当保姆，而不是委派任务。
4. 类似地，角色互动感觉冷冰冰的，机制上也很浅薄。GUI让顺畅管理对话和关系变得更加困难。RPG层面（任务、社交系统等）很表面。头一个小时左右还行，但之后我就完全跳过任务了。目前打捞玩法循环远比叙事系统强大。
5. 飞船规划器竟然在游戏之外？！？！飞船规划器独立于游戏之外，这令人费解。它显然仍处于alpha阶段，而且并不是特别用户友好。对大多数游戏内用途来说，它几乎没什么帮助。
需要的是某种集成且直观的东西，也就是更接近《监狱建筑师》里的规划系统。就目前而言，它与实际玩法完全脱节。
6. 经济平衡很差：仅仅几个小时后，跑了两三趟废料场，钱就完全不再是问题了。我目前坐拥900万太空美元。一旦你理解了打捞循环，就不存在真正的财务压力。
例如，我把一艘5万、没有可用引擎的小型残骸重建为一艘完整的太空巡洋舰，配有聚变反应堆、七个氢罐，以及足以进行3G加速的推力。最终价值：300万。这种成长感觉很棒，但经济曲线太平得太快了。

好消息：开发者显然触及到了某种特别的东西……游戏正在积极维护——仅去年就有35个补丁，其中包括7个大型补丁。更多内容正在路上（尽管即将到来的太空战斗补丁让一些人扬起了眉毛）。打捞机制有变化、有深度，还有一个真正引人入胜的、由系统驱动的核心。
如果开发者哪怕只解决上面列出的几个主要问题，这也很容易成为一款能提供数十甚至数百小时娱乐的游戏。
即便现在，它也是一款有缺陷但非常令人愉快的体验。
这就是为什么它得到了我的点赞。

items.text:
Before I say anything else, I would like to praise the game for having a depth and complexity of systems that has given me 50+ hours of game time, most of which were enjoyable, so the game receives high marks for that alone and its worth the price of admission.

Having said that, having invested 50+ hours of time into the game at the time of writing this, I've both seen and discovered through experimentation the limits of the game that has been developed so far, and I find myself frustrated with the constraints of what's been sorely overlooked and what clearly hasn't yet been finished.

The game implies and promises an open world with a diverse set of playstyles, but as things currently stand, the game is really only fully developed around one gameplay loop of one particular style of gameplay and not much else at the time of this review.

The core gameplay loop involves flying out to derelict vessels in the small system you start the game out in, boarding broken and abandoned ships and then salvaging any valuable loot or in-tact systems like reactors and fuel, fighting the ocassional pirate, then repairing, restoring, and selling those systems/loot on at station kiosks or the black market to steadily increase your bank account, allowing you to improve your ship and eventually earning enough to buy a bigger one, which in turn lets you haul more and more stuff on each of your salvaging trips.

There are, however, a few fundamental problems with this gameplay loop that'll eventually leave wanting wanting to stray from the formula, and the moment you do, you really start to see the glaring gaps in design and development not yet finished.

For starters, the vast, vast majority of ships you have access to at the start are very small, yet also very expensive.

You need a certain amount of space to make sure all your vital systems have room to be installed and maintained. This includes anything from your Nav console where you actually pilot the ship to the fuel canisters and intake valves you'll need to run the thrusters, the oxygen tank that gives life support, heating and cooling systems to keep the cabin conditions livable without an exo-suit, the transponder which is how the game handles your ship ID, ship batteries, and a number of alarm systems and wiring that strings it all together.

You need all of this to operate, AND you also need as much cabin space as possible to load the often very large and very cumbersome pieces of tech you strip from the other, bigger ships.

It won't be long before you realize you'll need a bigger ship to earn more money, but you'll quickly run into a fundamental problem in that, even on the blackmarket, in perfect restored condition, you are only ever going to earn $20,000 - $80,000 for the big items you take off the derelicts, of which you'll be lucky to fit only one or two onto your small starting ship.

The second issue you'll encounter is that, even with fast forward capabilities, everything takes a very, very long time to actually accomplish. Everything from uninstalling a componenet, to repairing it, to then restoring it, takes a lot of in-game time that can take minutes on end even at x16 speed, and that in itself is nothing compared to the tediousness of space travel and having to manually operate the docking and undocking procedure every time you need to land to travel anywhere.

The process of leaving the starting port, traveling to a derelict, docking there, stripping it for parts, traveling back to and docking at the port, repairing everything that's broken, then restoring everything to perfect condition for sale, even at high speeds, can often take you anywhere from 45 minutes to over an hour of IRL time, all for what amounts to only $80,000 - $120,000 of in-game currency.

This is not an economical use of time, especially when other expenses also chip away at your earnings, like constant docking fees and refueling needs for power, fuel, and oxygen, as well as a mortgage payment that kicks in every in-game shift and penalizes you with late fees if you forget to pay.

As it turns out, you don't even own the vessel you start out with, you have to pay off an expensive mortgage that ranges anywhere from $300,000 to over $2M depending on the vessel you wind up with in the beginning, so by the time you're feeling the inadequacies of your starting vessel not only do you not have any money to invest into buying a new one, but you have a mortage to pay off before you can even think about getting a new ship.

Even when you're stripping out valuable reactors and rare intake thrusters from giant derelicts, you will be playing most of the game in debt.

After the gameplay loop gets boring after awhile, this is where you'll be tempted into expanding into the other avenues of gameplay the game seems to offer, like paid delivery quests or even piracy, but sadly these are underdeveloped or not implemented at all.

As to quests, you'll contacted all the time with a hundred different quests that all sound interesting, but the trouble is there's no real way to track where any of them are. Certain NPCs on the port you start in will have some simple social quests to accomplish, but beyond that, the vast majority of the quests your receive both at random and at the "gig board" in the station wind up going to places that are currently inaccessible.

Many times the NPCs you need to talk to are on another vessel somewhere in space, with no real way of tracking where that vessel is where it's going. The rest of the time, you'll see lots of quests based in larger and different spaceports, but as things are in the game currently, you have absolutely no way to reach them.

All the ship systems that are currently in the game are, so far, designed only to travel around the small starting area. Other systems DO exist, but they are so so far away that no ship battery or fuel system currently exists that has the speed or longevity to reach them. With most current ship systems you have, at most, a few in-game days of power and fuel to travel.

The other systems are SO FAR away that even if you use all your fuel to max out your ship speed on normal thrusters, it will take you over a in-game year to reach your destination. Even if you magically could make sure your fuel never runs out and your batteries never die, your character has food, drink, and sleep gauges that need to be constantly micromanaged.

With salvaging parts taking too much time for not much money, and with the lucrative quest system mostly broken, you're not left with many legitimate ways to earn real money to buy better ships, so this is where you might start flirting with the idea of playing the game more like a pirate.

This IS fun for awhile, and raiding the smaller stations in the starting area's perimeter as well as patrol vessels turns out to be more of a guarantee of good loot than the random junk you can often wind up with docking with derelicts, but you still suffer from a lack of cargo space and its ultimately not any more time effective than salvaging.

This is where you might get the idea to start stealing patrol ships or finding larger derelicts and patching them up and taking them for yourself, but for me, this is where the game completely fell apart.

This is due to the biggest and most frustrating aspect about the entire game, and that's the ship registration and transponder system.

Everything your ship does, from paying your mortgage to docking at ports, is dependent on your Transponder ID.

If you uninstall your transponder it has an 80% chance to break, meaning you can't even dock at the home port anymore.
Even if you DO successfully uninstall it, it cannot be placed anywhere except your starting ship.
If you put it in a derelict you've repaired to working order? It doesn't work, put in a stolen patrol ship? Doesn't work.

This means there's no real way to have a ship other than buying one, so playing as a pirate? Not possible.

Very fun, but not finished.
items.text_zh:
在我开始说其他任何事情之前，我想先赞扬这款游戏，它拥有深度和复杂性的系统，给了我50多个小时的游戏时间，其中大部分时间都很愉快，所以仅凭这一点，这款游戏就获得了很高的评价，而且它的票价是值得的。

话虽如此，在撰写本文时，我已经在这款游戏上投入了50多个小时，我既看到了也通过实验发现了迄今为止所开发游戏的局限性，我发现自己对严重被忽视和明显尚未完成的内容的限制感到沮丧。

这款游戏暗示并承诺了一个拥有多样化玩法的开放世界，但就目前情况而言，在撰写这篇评测时，游戏实际上只围绕一种特定游戏风格的一个玩法循环进行了充分开发，除此之外别无其他。

核心玩法循环包括：飞往你开始游戏时所在的小星系中的废弃船只，登上破损和废弃的飞船，然后打捞任何有价值的战利品或完好的系统，如反应堆和燃料，偶尔与海盗战斗，然后在空间站售货亭或黑市上修理、恢复和出售这些系统/战利品，以稳步增加你的银行账户，让你能够改进你的飞船，并最终赚到足够的钱买一艘更大的飞船，这反过来又让你在每次打捞之旅中运送越来越多的东西。

然而，这个玩法循环存在一些根本性问题，最终会让你想要偏离这个公式，而当你这样做的那一刻，你真的开始看到设计和开发中尚未完成的明显空白。

首先，你在开始时可以使用的绝大多数飞船都非常小，但也非常昂贵。

你需要一定的空间来确保所有重要系统都有安装和维护的空间。这包括从你实际驾驶飞船的导航控制台，到运行推进器所需的燃料罐和进气阀，提供生命支持的氧气罐，使舱内条件在没有外骨骼服的情况下也能居住的加热和冷却系统，游戏用来处理你飞船ID的应答器，飞船电池，以及将这一切连接起来的若干警报系统和线路。

你需要所有这些才能运作，而且你还需要尽可能多的舱内空间来装载你从其他更大飞船上拆下的通常非常大且非常笨重的技术部件。

不久你就会意识到你需要一艘更大的飞船来赚更多的钱，但你很快就会遇到一个根本性问题：即使是在黑市上，以完美修复的状态，你从废弃船只上拆下的大件物品也只能卖到20,000到80,000美元，而你的小型起始飞船能装下一两个就算幸运了。

你会遇到的第二个问题是，即使有快进功能，一切实际上都需要非常非常长的时间才能完成。从卸载一个组件，到修理它，再到恢复它，都需要大量的游戏内时间，即使以16倍速度也可能需要连续几分钟，而这本身与太空旅行的乏味以及每次需要着陆前往任何地方时都必须手动操作对接和脱离对接程序相比，根本不算什么。

离开起始港口、前往废弃船只、在那里对接、拆解零件、返回
停靠到港口，修理所有损坏的东西，然后把一切恢复到完美状态以便出售，即使以高速进行，通常也会花费你45分钟到超过一个小时的现实时间，而这一切只换来相当于游戏内货币80,000到120,000美元的收入。

这不是对时间的划算利用，尤其是当其他开支也在蚕食你的收入时，比如持续的停靠费和为电力、燃料和氧气补给的需求，以及每个游戏内班次都会触发的抵押贷款还款，如果你忘记支付还会被处以滞纳金。

事实证明，你甚至并不拥有你一开始的那艘船，你必须偿还一笔昂贵的抵押贷款，金额从300,000美元到超过200万美元不等，取决于你一开始得到的是哪艘船，所以等到你感受到起始船只的不足时，你不仅没有任何钱可以投资购买新船，而且在你能考虑买新船之前还有一笔抵押贷款要还清。

即使你从巨大的废弃船只上拆下宝贵的反应堆和稀有的进气推进器，你在游戏的大部分时间里仍会处于负债状态。

在游戏循环过了一段时间变得无聊之后，这时你会被诱惑去拓展游戏似乎提供的其他玩法途径，比如付费送货任务甚至海盗行为，但遗憾的是这些内容要么开发不足，要么根本没有实现。

至于任务，你会一直被联系，收到上百个听起来都很有趣的不同任务，但问题在于没有真正的方法来追踪它们在哪里。你起始港口上的某些NPC会有一些简单的社交任务可以完成，但除此之外，你随机收到以及在空间站“任务板”上收到的大多数任务最终都指向目前无法到达的地方。

很多时候你需要交谈的NPC在太空某处的另一艘船上，而没有真正的方法追踪那艘船在哪里、要去哪里。其余时候，你会看到很多基于更大、不同太空港的任务，但按照游戏目前的情况，你绝对没有办法到达它们。

目前游戏中所有的飞船系统，到目前为止，都只是为了在小小的起始区域周围旅行而设计的。其他星系确实存在，但它们如此如此遥远，以至于目前不存在任何飞船电池或燃料系统拥有足够的速度或续航能力到达它们。以你目前拥有的大多数飞船系统，你最多只有几个游戏日的电力和燃料可供旅行。

其他星系是如此遥远，以至于即使你用尽所有燃料、用普通推进器将飞船速度开到最大，也需要超过一个游戏年才能到达目的地。即使你能神奇地确保燃料永不耗尽、电池永不枯竭，你的角色也有食物、饮水和睡眠指标需要不断微操管理。

由于打捞零件花费太多时间却赚不了多少钱，而利润丰厚的任务系统又大部分是坏的，你没有剩下多少合法途径来赚取真正的钱去购买更好的飞船，所以这时你可能会开始动起把游戏玩得更像海盗的念头。

这在一段时间内确实有趣，突袭起始区域外围的较小空间站以及巡逻船只，结果比停靠废弃船只时经常得到的随机垃圾更能保证获得好战利品，但你仍然受困于货舱空间不足
空间，而且它最终并不比打捞更省时间。

这就是你可能会产生开始偷巡逻船或寻找更大的废弃船只、把它们修补好并据为己有的想法的地方，但对我来说，这正是游戏彻底崩溃的地方。

这是由于整个游戏最大、最令人沮丧的方面，那就是船舶注册和应答器系统。

你的船所做的一切，从偿还抵押贷款到在港口停靠，都依赖于你的应答器ID。

如果你卸载应答器，它有80%的几率损坏，这意味着你甚至不能再在母港停靠。
即使你确实成功卸载了它，它也不能被放置在任何地方，除了你的起始船只。
如果你把它放进一艘你已经修复到可工作状态的废弃船只？它不工作，放进一艘偷来的巡逻船？不工作。

这意味着除了购买一艘船之外，没有真正的方法拥有船只，所以扮演海盗？不可能。

非常有趣，但尚未完成。

items.text:
The economy is so tightly tuned that you'll likely go broke just from docking fees, before you even get to refueling your ship. The tutorial directs you to derelict ships where you'll almost certainly be caught and fined for salvaging without a licence. A licence is $5000, the fine is $15,000. New characters will have ~$100, maybe $600 if you spend a year saving. With a new character's ship-breaking skills, it takes hours to break down any ship part into scrap worth more than a few dollars, and in those hours you'll likely be caught by cops and fined.

The UI is also incomprehensibly, unnecessarily bad. Obviously the ship's nav station is overwhelming and hard to use. But even just the station fuel kiosk is 10x more complex than it needs to be: your only UI for choosing how much fuel to buy is a draggable slider which makes it impossible to buy small amounts, and the kiosk shows four extra fuel types your ship can't use before the one it can.
items.text_zh:
经济系统被调得如此紧绷，以至于你很可能光是付停靠费就破产了，还没等到给飞船加油呢。教程会把你引向废弃飞船，在那里你几乎肯定会被抓住，并因无证打捞而被罚款。执照要5000美元，罚款是15000美元。新角色大约会有100美元，如果攒上一年，也许能有600美元。以新角色的拆船技能，要把任何飞船部件拆解成价值超过几美元的废料都得花上好几个小时，而在这几个小时里，你很可能会被警察抓住并罚款。

A bit clunky, a lot cluttered, not very clear. However, these are all acceptable for an early access game. 
The game itself? GET IT
If you're the kind of person who likes manuals, games like Rings of Saturn, or is a hard sci-fi fan. 

In my opinion needs workshop support to get the perfect experience. Mods to create custom characters for example. You can do that now of course, but you're fairly limited imo.

Also needs a better social interaction system, not necessarily a complete overhaul but pretty close.

You can put on a pressure suit, uninstall a floor tile, and space an entire station 30 seconds into the game. The only  thing that will stop you is if a security guard spots you, in which case a pop-up event will happen, you will age 3 or so years in prison, and then you're right back to the same spaced space station, seconds after you got arrested, to which everyone without a pressure suit or Eva suit proceeds to die. You have no further consequences.

Also, despite having a "slow metabolism" why does my character get SO hungry? Compared to thirst, hunger is RAPID. You'll need 2-3 meals before a drink of water.

Combat is also in the same boat. Somehow a pirate will be fine alone on a hunk of junk floating in space, no starvation/dehydration or environment exposure, who then is completely fine to try and murder you for your stuff. Except somehow it's very easy to win by just spamming a stab attack. At which point if they don't surrender, they die. If they do surrender, they hop aboard your ship as they slowly bleed out, and then randomly turn hostile again as if you didn't just nearly kill them before halfway back to the station. (I think there are handcuffs but i've never found any if so)

Also I don't know if there is any ship-to-ship combat but if not there NEEDS to be. Even if it's a dlc it's a must.

Runs well too, my gpu died recently and with some minor adjustments the game ran fine on my igpu, and looked pretty good still too.

Translation issues, and would be nice to be able to choose one language at a time, right now it shows both of them at once most of the time. Objects, npc's, and you are referred to as 'us' for details and status effect descriptions.

Also, you can spend an entire year of your life in character customization to maybe raise a few hundred dollars, but you can spend 2 irl minutes the second you get into the game to do a delivery gig that takes like 20 seconds and awards thousands if you do it fast? (as in, pause scumming to save every second spent in menus or inventory. If you dont It's not actually possible to get the highest payment tier from what i've seen)

Lot's of issues that need addressing, but the core game is actually quite well done. As long as they address the small issues, my review will remain positive, 

They also are great at fixing all the small stuff, tons of updates with tons of goodies, so far.

有点笨拙，非常杂乱，不太清晰。不过，对于一款抢先体验游戏来说，这些都是可以接受的。
游戏本身呢？买它
如果你是那种喜欢说明书的人，喜欢《土星环》这类游戏，或者是个硬科幻迷。

在我看来，需要创意工坊支持才能获得完美体验。比如用模组创建自定义角色。当然你现在也能这么做，但我觉得相当受限。

还需要更好的社交互动系统，不一定要彻底重做，但也差不多了。

你可以在游戏开始30秒内穿上压力服，拆下一块地板砖，把整个空间站扔进太空。唯一能阻止你的是被保安发现，那样会触发一个弹窗事件，你会在监狱里度过大约3年，然后你立刻又回到那个被扔进太空的空间站，就在你被捕几秒之后，所有没有压力服或EVA服的人都会死掉。你没有进一步的后果。

还有，明明有“新陈代谢缓慢”，为什么我的角色还是那么饿？和口渴相比，饥饿来得太快了。喝一杯水之前你得吃2-3顿饭。

战斗也是同样的情况。不知怎么的，一个海盗独自待在一块漂浮在太空中的破铜烂铁上会安然无恙，没有饥饿/脱水或环境暴露的问题，然后他完全有精力为了你的东西试图谋杀你。只不过不知为何，只要狂点刺击攻击就很容易赢。到那时，如果他们不投降，就会死。如果他们投降了，他们会一边慢慢流血一边跳上你的船，然后在回空间站半路上又随机变得敌对，就好像你刚才没有差点杀了他们一样。（我想是有手铐的，但如果有的话我从没找到过）

还有，我不知道有没有舰对舰战斗，但如果没有的话，那必须有。就算是DLC也必须有。

运行也很流畅，我的显卡最近坏了，稍微调整了一下，游戏在我的核显上运行得很好，看起来也依然相当不错。

翻译问题，而且能一次只选一种语言就好了，现在大多数时候两种语言会同时显示。物体、NPC和你自己在细节和状态效果描述中都被称为“我们”。

还有，你可以在角色自定义上花掉一整年的生命，也许只能多赚几百美元，但你可以在进入游戏后的2分钟现实时间里接一个送货任务，任务耗时大概20秒，如果做得快就能奖励数千美元？（也就是说，通过暂停刷时间来节省在菜单或物品栏里花费的每一秒。如果你不这么做，据我所见，实际上不可能拿到最高报酬等级）

有很多问题需要解决，但核心游戏其实做得相当不错。只要他们解决这些小问题，我的评价就会保持正面。

他们也很擅长修复所有小问题，到目前为止有大量更新和大量好东西。

思量再三，最后还是决定购买这款游戏，我对很多ea阶段的游戏包有很多不切实际的期待，可我明知结果并非如此。

这款游戏只能用极低的容错率来进行游玩，并且目前抢先测试版本并没有多少任务内容，也没有更多的剧情来驱动游戏体验。

如果你喜欢模拟经营类的游戏，只能在后期游戏的阶段才能享受到这种乐趣。

前期的拆船和捡废品的所能赚的钱十分有限，并且工作亭有个种类的任务要求你去攻击某人还会让你惹上很多麻烦。
当海盗在游戏内不是一种选项，你很有可能因为袭击他人被罚款更多的金钱。

同样被海盗袭击导致人财两空或者因为没有打捞证被警察罚款和捉进监狱的情况更是屡屡皆是。除非你能摸到法律边缘，以最低的道德底线作为守法公民才能赚到更多的钱.

开船的体验感觉很新颖，可实际上非常不舒服的操作手感，在后面变成了玩家的负担。和船体接轨过程更是让开船的难受程度更上一层楼。

就ea阶段的总体评价而言：我个人不推荐任何人购买游玩.但我希望能好评鼓励开发商认真制作自己的游戏,并且认识到其中的不足之处.

I really want to like this game, and mechanically it seems quite fun. 

However that all gets thrown out the game when it just decides to end your save.

to summarize my experience, i read through all of the manual except the parts about the nuclear reactor, (while doing that i tab out reply to some discord messages, have to go replace some fire alarm batteries.) go into a game, follow the tutorial get to my first ship i dock to it. i literally docked to a front half of a docking clamp, to a wreckage thats like 20 wall tiles, 15 floor tiles, some scrap and a corpse. 

i then get pulled over by the police for illegal salvaging, something i didn't even actually realize was illegal until i see the message from them pulling me over. ( i think the manuel mentions it, but its like 8 pages of technical stuff when you just want to get into playing a game so it doesn't exactly all stick) i get fined 15,000 ( i started with 98.0) i have no idea why i got pulled over and how to stop that, maybe i wasn't supposed to stay that long at the site, maybe you are supposed to turn off your transponder who knows. game or manual doesn't mention anything. 

i eventually go back to the starting station, after mildly looting a 2nd wreckage that seemed to have a very bugged out procedural generation. trying to only take what i can quickly grab with my transponder off to hopefully not get found by the police again. at this point i'm down to 30% rcs fuel so i head back to the station i spawned at to sell all the scrap and N2 canister i yoinked, plus some pda's i grabbed. turned in a dead pirates bounty i found in the 2nd ship. all in all, made about 2k ish. i pay off all my station fees hoping i can ignore the police fine for awhile, (basically cost all my money to pay for docking) get told i can't leave without paying the 15k. i go to the station authority to see if i can get an extension or something. ( a dude who earlier called me on the station speakers, and asked me to plant a bug on some other dude, AND DIDN'T PAY ME OR ANYTHING FOR IT.) dude says no when i request to pay it next time. 

so the save is basically bricked. i can't leave the station until i earn over 7 times what i earned in my entire time in the game over 3 hours. the only way i could maybe get out of this i found was to do kiosk jobs to local deliveries. but the kisok jobs actively suck. if you try to take one, it doesn't let you unless you are at the specific one thats the pick up point, but by the time you move from the one you checked to the pick up point the job has despawned. thus its actually impossible without very lucky rng to even pick up one of the jobs. all while the station fines you for being docked by the hour. and it seems you have to pay to pick up the jobs. 

can't even refund cause it took me 3 hours to go through all this. 

but yeah. TL;DR game has some fun mechanics, but your save can get completely bricked by something it doesn't even really tell you is a thing, and then theres nothing you can do to recover. when all you did was LITERALLY LISTEN TO THE TUTORIAL. if they let salvaging without a license be legal then it'd be a really fun game. (which by the way is 5k a day. again literally 2.5 times more than i made in 3 hours of playing, and if i recall almost a full in game day.)
items.text_zh:
我真的很想喜欢这款游戏，而且从机制上看它似乎相当有趣。

然而，当它突然决定终结你的存档时，这一切都被抛到了九霄云外。

总结一下我的经历：我读完了整本手册，除了关于核反应堆的部分，（读的时候我切出去回复了一些Discord消息，还得去换一些火灾报警器的电池。）进入游戏，跟着教程走，到达了我的第一艘船，我停靠了上去。我实际上停靠到了一个对接夹的前半部分，连着一堆大约20块墙砖、15块地砖、一些废料和一具尸体的残骸。

然后我因为非法打捞被警察拦下了，直到我看到他们拦停我的消息之前，我甚至都没意识到这是违法的。（我想手册里提到过，但那大概是8页的技术性内容，而你只是想赶紧开始玩游戏，所以它并不完全能让人记住。）我被罚款15,000（我一开始只有98.0）。我完全不知道自己为什么被拦下，也不知道怎么避免这种情况，也许我不该在那个地点停留那么久，也许你应该关掉你的应答器，谁知道呢。游戏或手册都没有提到任何相关内容。

i最终回到了起始空间站，在那之前我稍微洗劫了第二个残骸，那个残骸的程序生成似乎有严重的bug。我尽量只拿那些能快速抓取的东西，同时关掉应答器，希望能不再被警察发现。此时我的RCS燃料只剩下30%，所以我回到了我出生的空间站，卖掉了我顺来的所有废料和N2罐，还有我拿的一些PDA。上交了我在第二艘船上找到的一个死海盗的赏金。总而言之，赚了大约2千左右。我付清了所有空间站费用，希望可以暂时无视警察的罚款，（基本上花光了我所有的钱来支付停靠费）结果被告知不付那15k就不能离开。我去找空间站管理局，看看能不能延期什么的。（就是之前通过空间站扬声器呼叫我，让我去给另一个人装窃听器，而且没付我钱也没给任何报酬的那个人。）当我请求下次再付时，那家伙说不行。

所以这个存档基本上算是废了。在赚到超过我整个游戏3小时里所赚的7倍之前，我无法离开空间站。我发现的唯一可能摆脱困境的方法是做自助终端的工作，比如本地送货。但自助终端的工作烂透了。如果你想接一个，除非你正好在特定的取货点，否则它不让你接，但等你从你查看的那个终端移动到取货点时，工作已经消失了。因此，除非运气极好，否则根本不可能接到任何一个工作。与此同时，空间站还按小时对你停靠收费。而且看起来你还得付钱才能接这些工作。

甚至没法退款，因为我花了3个小时才经历完这一切。

但没错。TL;DR 游戏有一些有趣的机制，但你的存档可能会被一些它甚至没有真正告诉过你存在的东西彻底搞废，然后你对此无能为力。而你所做的只是字面意义上地听从了教程。如果他们让无证打捞合法化，那它会是一款非常有趣的游戏。（顺便说一下，许可证是每天5千。再次强调，这字面意义上是我玩3个小时所赚的2.5倍多，如果我没记错的话，差不多是整整一个游戏日。）

The games pretty janky. Maybe 50% done. It comes with no tutorial, no wiki, no hints on how to start.
Its like singleplayer SpaceStation 13 but without the wacky fun. Or much fun at all.
The game lore and story pages warn of stealing whole ships and getting in trouble with the law, but you cant pirate a ship and sell it off. You sorta have to cut the ship apart and sell it in pieces that fit in your little dinghy all while paying a huge mortgage on that boat four times a day.
The money curve is all off, for a game that tries to be about scavenging ships its more $/hr couriering bottles of vodka and patches between train stations. Safer too since you dont run into odd situations where you become wanted for unknown reasons and slapped with $15k fines when you're trying to get $800 to pay your docking fees. And then you come across a ship with a fusion reactor just sitting there and its worth $100k-200k and poof there goes your money troubles, and the whole point of playing.

Hold off, maybe in a year.

这游戏相当粗糙。大概完成了50%。它没有附带教程，没有wiki，没有如何开始的提示。

再等等吧，也许一年后。

items.text:
Entertaining, for early access.
-Fun to learn while dying type game
-Awesome character generation, repeats after a few times
-Fixing/building your ship is fun while it is breaking down
-Cops coming for you to check on your license is funny
-Crew social is very interesting, buggy, but interesting

Really needs a lot more work though - bugs from 1/12/23:
-After visiting a few derelicts and having a lot of stuff on your ship, it will start becoming choppy/low fps
-The orders management is cool, yet fails/crashes a lot
-Inventory UI is horrible, cannot change the size of the huge text, you accidentally click off one of the tiny inventory boxes you move, which is both annoying and sometimes rarely useful
-Social UI is horrible, cannot change the size of the small text
-Trade UI is horrible, have to scroll every time you open a sub-list
-Esc key, escapes everything except right click menu
-The crew will constantly interrupt you, repair a hole in the hull, doesn’t matter
-No good way to get crew to stop interrupting aside from mod, which removes it completely
-Crew will constantly go outside without helmets and die lock doors if you could get all the codes
-Crew dying on another ship, you cannot drag them to your ship, fire them and leave them to die (or extra eva suit)
-Cops will ram you
-Bugs/lacking in many ship systems, airlocks are almost pointless since you cannot automate them and lose air fast. (sure you can manually vacuum the space, but the manual controls are full screen for a tiny panel and a just get annoying after a while)
-Nav station won’t list all door codes, and you have guess which door is which code
-Lots of skills are useless, some do a little, 4 of them do a lot
-Making money/economy is weird - you can get a lot of stuff, but cannot sell it all. If you have a loan, you will be bogged down in bills, store refreshes every 4 shifts, but you have to pay the loan every shift... So you get the ship that doesn't have a loan and then it becomes pointless
-Yeah you can jettison stuff.... one at a time.... 100s of trash.... ugh

Wishes: 
-multiplayer, or at least better crew. 
-Easy way to make ships and add them to the game without modding. 
-Simple switch automation (at least a proximity switch)
-By the time you find the Cart, you really don’t need the cart
-Simple crafting - cart, change 02 sensor to N2, cart, blue light to red light, cart

Tldr: After 100+ hours played, the bugs will beat you into not wanting to play this awesome game. Worth $20, yea
items.text_zh:
在抢先体验阶段，这游戏挺有意思的。
- 边死边学的那种游戏，很好玩
- 角色生成很棒，但重复几次后就腻了
- 飞船一边坏一边修/造还挺有趣的
- 警察来查你的执照很好笑
- 船员社交非常有意思，有bug，但有意思

不过真的还需要大量打磨——截至23年1月12日的bug：
- 访问了几艘废弃飞船、船上东西多了之后，游戏会开始卡顿/掉帧
- 命令管理系统很酷，但经常失效/崩溃
- 物品栏UI很糟糕，没法调整巨大文本的大小，你移动那些小物品栏格子时一不小心就会点到外面，既烦人又偶尔有点用
- 社交UI很糟糕，没法调整小文本的大小
- 交易UI很糟糕，每次打开子列表都得滚动
- Esc键，什么都能退出，就是退不出右键菜单
- 船员会不停地打断你，哪怕是在修补船体上的破洞，也一样
- 除了用mod（而且mod会把它完全移除）之外，没有好办法让船员停止打断你
- 船员会不停地不戴头盔就跑到外面去然后死掉，如果能拿到所有密码的话倒是可以把门锁上
- 船员在另一艘船上死了，你没法把他们拖到你的船上，只能解雇他们、任他们去死（或者多备一套EVA服）
- 警察会撞你
- 许多飞船系统有bug/不完善，气闸几乎毫无意义，因为你没法自动化它们，而且漏气很快。（当然你可以手动给空间抽真空，但手动控制是一个小面板却占满全屏，过一会儿就让人烦）
- 导航站不会列出所有门的密码，你得猜哪个门对应哪个密码
- 很多技能没用，有些有点用，有4个技能作用很大
- 赚钱/经济系统很奇怪——你能搞到很多东西，但没法全卖掉。如果你有贷款，你会被账单压得喘不过气，商店每4个班次刷新一次，但你每个班次都得还贷款……所以你就只能选那艘没有贷款的船，然后贷款系统就变得毫无意义
- 是啊，你可以把东西扔出去……一次一个……几百件垃圾……唉

愿望：
- 多人模式，或者至少把船员做好点。
- 有简单的方法造船并把它们加进游戏，不用做mod。
- 简单的开关自动化（至少来个接近开关）
- 等你找到购物车的时候，你其实已经不需要购物车了
- 简单的合成——购物车，把O2传感器换成N2，购物车，把蓝灯换成红灯，购物车

长话短说：玩了100多个小时之后，这些bug会把你折磨到不想再玩这款超棒的游戏。值20美元，是的
